''See also: [[Prince Veshran Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Prince Veshran is a member of the [[Karoshan]] royal family and serves as the twin brother to [[the Queen]]. Physically, he is a tall individual characterized by bronze skin and long, bright hair-cables that possess a golden hue. In his interactions with others, such as the Captain, he can be intimidating and confrontational, often using his physical presence to loom over others or demanding direct engagement. He is deeply involved in the political landscape of [[Karosha]] and has expressed significant disapproval regarding certain alliances, specifically expressing outrage over dealings with the [[Union]]. Veshran is also critical of his sister's leadership, advising her to take decisive action to maintain the loyalty of her subjects and arguing against showing mercy to vulnerable enemies.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Veshran is the twin brother of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]. He also maintains an independent status from [[Felrex]] through various alliances and repositioning.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Prince Veshran is a bronze-skinned [[Karoshan]] male with bright, shining golden hair-cables. As the twin brother of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]], he serves as [[the Queen]]'s political representative in court and governs a colony located within [[Alliance space]]. Though he is described as strict, he remains an earnest leader who has maintained independence from [[Felrex]] through strategic alliances and repositioning. Veshran commands a fleet and leads a [[Karoshan legion]], eventually providing people for the crew to protect during their retreat.}}
